## 1.09PROTECTIONOFWORK,PROPERTYANDPERSONS

1. Provide necessary methods, supervision, materials, and construction to ensure that no soiling, staining, damage, or other disfigurement or harm to any part of the Works, materials, property, work of other contractors, and persons results from the work in progress, and from the effects of heat, humidity, moisture, dust, and sand. Construction facilities relating to protection are specified in Section 01500.
2.
